premise: In the morning fog Acorn counts her friends for a game and always gets one too few; they search for the missing one until Ladybug counts again and finds who Acorn forgot: Acorn.
inspiration: The folk tale of the travellers who each forget to count themselves (the Wise Men of Gotham), turned into a counting game where the one who was missing was right there, counting.

en-US.title: Acorn Counts Her Friends
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [excited] One misty morning, {acorn:enter} Acorn wanted to play hide-and-seek. {acorn:hop x2} "But first, let's count who's playing! {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:pulse} Ladybug, one. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:pulse} Hedgehog, two. {mouse:enter} {mouse:pulse} Mouse, three." {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] "Three? But we're four! Someone's missing!" {mouse:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} Mouse sniffed the misty air. Nobody there. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Hedgehog curled up tight to think. {acorn:live talk} "Oh, look, a pebble!" said Acorn. {hedgehog:live curl resume} "It's ME," said Hedgehog, peeking out. [giggles] So Acorn counted again, very carefully. "Ladybug, one. Hedgehog, two. Mouse, three." {acorn:face sad} Still three! {acorn:live wish hold} She squeezed her eyes tight and wished: "Please, let us find who's missing." {ladybug:go to acorn} Ladybug crawled over. [playfully] "Let ME count. {ladybug:live talk} Hedgehog, one. Mouse, two. Me, three. And… {ladybug:sparkle} YOU, four!" {acorn:live wish resume} Acorn opened her eyes. {canvas:fog stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} {sfx:birds} The fog lifted, and there they all were: one, two, three, FOUR. {acorn:face happy} [laughs] She had forgotten to count herself! {all:face happy} {all:wobble x2} Everyone laughed. And ever since, when Acorn counts, she always starts like this: "Acorn… ONE!"

es-ES.title: Bellota cuenta a sus amigos
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [excited] Una mañana de niebla, a {acorn:enter} Bellota le entraron ganas de jugar al escondite. {acorn:hop x2} —¡Pero antes hay que contar cuántos somos! {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:pulse} Mariquita, uno. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:pulse} Erizo, dos. {mouse:enter} {mouse:pulse} Ratón, tres. {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] ¿Tres? ¡Pero si somos cuatro! ¡Aquí falta alguien! {mouse:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} Ratón husmeó entre la niebla. Ni rastro. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Erizo se hizo una bola para pensar mejor. {acorn:live talk} —¡Anda, una piedra! —dijo Bellota. {hedgehog:live curl resume} —¡Que soy YO! —protestó Erizo, asomando el hocico. [giggles] Bellota volvió a contar, despacito: —Mariquita, uno. Erizo, dos. Ratón, tres. {acorn:face sad} ¡Otra vez tres! {acorn:live wish hold} Apretó los ojos y pidió un deseo: —Por favor, que encontremos al que falta. {ladybug:go to acorn} Mariquita se acercó. [playfully] —A ver, déjame a MÍ. {ladybug:live talk} Erizo, uno. Ratón, dos. Yo, tres. Y… {ladybug:sparkle} ¡TÚ, cuatro! {acorn:live wish resume} Bellota abrió los ojos. {canvas:fog stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} {sfx:birds} Se levantó la niebla, y allí estaban todos: uno, dos, tres y ¡CUATRO! {acorn:face happy} [laughs] ¡Se le había olvidado contarse a ella misma! {all:face happy} {all:wobble x2} Todos se partieron de risa. Y desde entonces, cuando Bellota cuenta, siempre empieza así: —Bellota… ¡UNO!

ja-JP.title: どんぐり、なかまを かぞえる
ja-JP.text: {canvas:fog 0.6}[excited]きりの朝、{acorn:enter}どんぐりは、かくれんぼがしたくなりました。{acorn:hop x2}「まず、かぞえよう！{ladybug:enter}{ladybug:pulse}テントウムシさん、ひとり。{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:pulse}ハリネズミくん、ふたり。{mouse:enter}{mouse:pulse}ネズミくん、さんにん。」 {acorn:face surprised}[gasps]「あれ？よにんのはずなのに！」 {mouse:live sniff}{sfx:sniff}ネズミくんが、くんくん。だれもいません。{hedgehog:live curl hold}ハリネズミくんは、まるくなって、うーん。{acorn:live talk}「あら、石ころ！」 とどんぐり。{hedgehog:live curl resume}「ぼくだよ！」 とハリネズミくん。[giggles]もういちど、ゆっくりかぞえます。「テントウムシさん、ハリネズミくん、ネズミくん…」 {acorn:face sad}やっぱり、さんにん！{acorn:live wish hold}目をぎゅっとつぶって、「いない子が、見つかりますように。」 {ladybug:go to acorn}テントウムシさんが、ちょこちょこ。[playfully]「わたしがかぞえる。{ladybug:live talk}ハリネズミくん、ひとり。ネズミくん、ふたり。わたし、さんにん。それから…{ladybug:sparkle}あなたで、よにん！」 {acorn:live wish resume}目をあけると、{canvas:fog stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s}{sfx:birds}きりがはれて…ひとり、ふたり、さんにん、よにん！{acorn:face happy}[laughs]じぶんを、かぞえわすれていたのです！{all:face happy}{all:wobble x2}みんなで大わらい。それからは、かぞえるときはいつもこう。「どんぐり…ひとり！」

de-DE.title: Die Eichel zählt ihre Freunde
de-DE.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [excited] An einem nebligen Morgen wollte {acorn:enter} die Eichel Verstecken spielen. {acorn:hop x2} „Aber erst zählen wir, wer mitspielt! {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:pulse} Marienkäfer, eins. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:pulse} Igel, zwei. {mouse:enter} {mouse:pulse} Maus, drei.“ {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] „Drei? Wir sind doch vier! Da fehlt einer!“ {mouse:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} Die Maus schnupperte in den Nebel. Niemand da. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Der Igel rollte sich zum Nachdenken ein. {acorn:live talk} „Oh, guckt mal, ein Kieselstein!“, rief die Eichel. {hedgehog:live curl resume} „Das bin ICH!“, sagte der Igel und streckte die Nase heraus. [giggles] Die Eichel zählte noch mal, ganz genau: „Marienkäfer, eins. Igel, zwei. Maus, drei.“ {acorn:face sad} Schon wieder drei! {acorn:live wish hold} Sie kniff die Augen fest zu und wünschte sich: „Bitte, lass uns finden, wer fehlt.“ {ladybug:go to acorn} Der Marienkäfer krabbelte herbei. [playfully] „Lass MICH mal zählen. {ladybug:live talk} Igel, eins. Maus, zwei. Ich, drei. Und… {ladybug:sparkle} DU, vier!“ {acorn:live wish resume} Die Eichel machte die Augen auf. {canvas:fog stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} {sfx:birds} Der Nebel verzog sich, und da waren sie alle: eins, zwei, drei, VIER. {acorn:face happy} [laughs] Sie hatte vergessen, sich selbst mitzuzählen! {all:face happy} {all:wobble x2} Alle lachten. Seitdem fängt die Eichel beim Zählen immer so an: „Eichel… EINS!“

fr-FR.title: Gland compte ses amis
fr-FR.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [excited] Un matin de brume, {acorn:enter} Gland avait envie de jouer à cache-cache. {acorn:hop x2} « Mais d’abord, on compte les joueurs ! {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:pulse} Coccinelle, un. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:pulse} Hérisson, deux. {mouse:enter} {mouse:pulse} Souris, trois. » {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] « Trois ? Mais on est quatre ! Il manque quelqu’un ! » {mouse:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} Souris a reniflé la brume, snif, snif. Personne. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Hérisson s’est roulé en boule pour réfléchir. {acorn:live talk} « Oh, regardez, un caillou ! » a dit Gland. {hedgehog:live curl resume} « C’est MOI ! » a fait Hérisson en pointant le nez. [giggles] Alors Gland a recompté, bien lentement. « Coccinelle, un. Hérisson, deux. Souris, trois. » {acorn:face sad} Encore trois ! {acorn:live wish hold} Les yeux bien fermés, il a fait un vœu : « Pourvu qu’on retrouve celui qui manque ! » {ladybug:go to acorn} Coccinelle s’est approchée. [playfully] « Laisse-MOI compter. {ladybug:live talk} Hérisson, un. Souris, deux. Moi, trois. Et… {ladybug:sparkle} TOI, quatre ! » {acorn:live wish resume} Gland a ouvert les yeux. {canvas:fog stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} {sfx:birds} La brume s’est levée, et ils étaient tous là : un, deux, trois, QUATRE ! {acorn:face happy} [laughs] Gland avait oublié de se compter lui-même ! {all:face happy} {all:wobble x2} Tout le monde a éclaté de rire. Et depuis, quand Gland compte, il commence toujours comme ça : « Gland… UN ! »

it-IT.title: Ghianda conta gli amici
it-IT.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [excited] Una mattina di nebbia, {acorn:enter} Ghianda aveva una gran voglia di giocare a nascondino. {acorn:hop x2} «Ma prima contiamo chi gioca! {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:pulse} Coccinella, uno. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:pulse} Riccio, due. {mouse:enter} {mouse:pulse} Topolino, tre.» {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] «Tre? Ma noi siamo quattro! Qui manca qualcuno!» {mouse:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} Topolino ha annusato la nebbia, snif, snif. Nessuno. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Riccio si è chiuso a palla per pensare meglio. {acorn:live talk} «Oh, guardate, un sasso!» ha detto Ghianda. {hedgehog:live curl resume} «Sono IO!» ha protestato Riccio, tirando fuori il nasino. [giggles] Allora Ghianda ha contato di nuovo, piano piano. «Coccinella, uno. Riccio, due. Topolino, tre.» {acorn:face sad} Ancora tre! {acorn:live wish hold} Ha stretto forte gli occhi e ha espresso un desiderio: «Per favore, fa' che troviamo chi manca!» {ladybug:go to acorn} Coccinella si è avvicinata. [playfully] «Adesso conto IO. {ladybug:live talk} Riccio, uno. Topolino, due. Io, tre. E… {ladybug:sparkle} TU, quattro!» {acorn:live wish resume} Ghianda ha aperto gli occhi. {canvas:fog stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} {sfx:birds} La nebbia si è alzata, ed eccoli lì, tutti quanti: uno, due, tre, QUATTRO! {acorn:face happy} [laughs] Ghianda si era dimenticata di contare se stessa! {all:face happy} {all:wobble x2} E tutti sono scoppiati a ridere. Da quel giorno, quando Ghianda conta, comincia sempre così: «Ghianda… UNO!»

zh-TW.title: 橡實數朋友
zh-TW.text: {canvas:fog 0.6}[excited]一個霧濛濛的早晨，{acorn:enter}橡實想玩躲貓貓。{acorn:hop x2}「不過，先來數數看，誰要一起玩！{ladybug:enter}{ladybug:pulse}瓢蟲，一。{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:pulse}刺蝟，二。{mouse:enter}{mouse:pulse}小老鼠，三。」 {acorn:face surprised}[gasps]「三個？我們明明有四個呀！少了一個！」 {mouse:live sniff}{sfx:sniff}小老鼠在霧裡嗅嗅嗅。沒有人。{hedgehog:live curl hold}刺蝟縮成一顆球，用力想一想。{acorn:live talk}「咦，這裡有一顆石頭！」 橡實說。{hedgehog:live curl resume}「是我啦！」 刺蝟探出頭來。[giggles]於是橡實又數了一次，數得好仔細：「瓢蟲，一。刺蝟，二。小老鼠，三。」 {acorn:face sad}還是三個！{acorn:live wish hold}她緊緊閉上眼睛，許了一個願：「拜託，讓我們找到不見的那一個。」 {ladybug:go to acorn}瓢蟲爬了過來。[playfully]「換我來數！{ladybug:live talk}刺蝟，一。小老鼠，二。我，三。還有……{ladybug:sparkle}你，四！」 {acorn:live wish resume}橡實睜開眼睛。{canvas:fog stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s}{sfx:birds}霧散了，大家都在這裡：一、二、三、四！{acorn:face happy}[laughs]原來，她忘了數自己！{all:face happy}{all:wobble x2}大家笑成一團。從那天起，橡實每次數數，一定先這樣數：「橡實……一！」

zh-HK.title: 橡實數人頭
zh-HK.text: {canvas:fog 0.6}[excited]一個霧濛濛的早上，{acorn:enter}橡實想玩捉迷藏。{acorn:hop x2}「不過，我哋先數吓有幾多個一齊玩！{ladybug:enter}{ladybug:pulse}瓢蟲，一。{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:pulse}刺蝟，二。{mouse:enter}{mouse:pulse}小老鼠，三。」 {acorn:face surprised}[gasps]「三個？我哋明明有四個㗎！少咗一個呀！」 {mouse:live sniff}{sfx:sniff}小老鼠在霧裏嗅呀嗅，連影子也看不見。{hedgehog:live curl hold}刺蝟縮成一個刺球，用心地想呀想。{acorn:live talk}「咦，呢度有粒石仔！」 橡實說。{hedgehog:live curl resume}「唔係石仔，係我呀！」 刺蝟探出頭來說。[giggles]於是橡實再數一次，數得好小心：「瓢蟲，一。刺蝟，二。小老鼠，三。」 {acorn:face sad}還是三個！{acorn:live wish hold}她緊緊閉上眼睛，許了一個願：「拜託拜託，等我哋搵返唔見咗嗰個啦。」 {ladybug:go to acorn}瓢蟲爬了過來。[playfully]「等我嚟數！{ladybug:live talk}刺蝟，一。小老鼠，二。我，三。仲有……{ladybug:sparkle}你，四！」 {acorn:live wish resume}橡實張開眼睛。{canvas:fog stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s}{sfx:birds}霧散了，大家都在這裏：一、二、三、四！{acorn:face happy}[laughs]原來她數漏了自己！{all:face happy}{all:wobble x2}大家笑成一團。從此以後，橡實每次數人頭，第一個一定數自己：「橡實……一！」
